race.comment: MAQUISA (14) doesn't win out of turn but gets the nod after a strong run of form in better company, finishing third in Saturday company at Eagle Farm after a close second at Doomben. She's yet to win at this distance but has placed five times from seven attempts, handles soft ground and brings the most reliable recent profile. ROLLING HOME (9) is the progressive danger, having won a CL1 at Scone before a sound third at Hawkesbury as favourite. At his top now fourth-up and is drawn cosy. ELUSIVE DOMINA (12) rises from a BM62 win at the Sunny Coast, but she has two wins at this trip and a strong record with Tiffani Brooker, so she remains a genuine winning hope. SUPER DUCK (1) was only run down late here last time and should look to lead them again third-up. Keeping safe for a minor spot.
